posts.title: How Not to Use AI
posts.description: I just had a day where I ran into bad AI usage pattern – four times. They are all non-code work. So I’m writing this. Core principle: don’t replace your judgment with AI. In my last AI talk at Townhall – I said LLMs are probabilistic machines. They output tokens at certain probabilities, some correct, some wrong. That’s why we build harnesses in code. In non-code work, the same principle holds.
